contentText: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday denied what he called "fake news" that Israel had dragged US President Donald Trump into war with Iran. "Does anyone really think that someone can tell President Trump what to do?" Netanyahu told journalist at a press conference. Reporting from Jerusalem, FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky explains that Netanyahu's remarks were directed to an audience of one: Donald Trump.
